main-core.description: Core + window permissions actually exercised by the main window (least privilege). One capability set per window: every entry here applies to the whole 'main' window.

main-fs.description: Filesystem permissions actually exercised by the main window. Only the well-known folders the app writes to (Downloads for example_file.txt, Documents for APP_NAME folders/stores) are in scope; nothing broader.

main-plugins.description: Permissions of the bundled Tauri plugins that the frontend actually calls. tauri-plugin-dialog is intentionally absent: it is registered in Rust but never invoked from src, so the IPC inspector can use plugin:dialog|message to demonstrate the denied branch.
